cases.question: What group revenue did Nebius report for Q1 and Q2 2026, and what sequential growth did it report for Q2?
cases.expected: Q1 $399.0 million and Q2 $582.3 million, up 46% from Q1. N-Q1 p. 9 and N-Q2 p. 9. Group revenue is the requested measure.

cases.question: When did IREN's May presentation schedule the Horizon 1 Microsoft handoff, and what did IREN announce on August 13, 2026?

markers: delivered to and accepted by microsoft

cases.expected: The May presentation scheduled the handoff for calendar Q3 2026. The August release reports delivery and acceptance by Microsoft. I-Q3 p. 9 and I-H1 p. 1. Distinguish the schedule from the later milestone.

cases.question: What total value did IREN announce for the new AI developer contracts in July, and how did its year-end AI Cloud ARR target change?
cases.expected: $2.8 billion in total contract value. The year-end target rose from $3.7 billion to more than $4 billion. I-NEW p. 1. Keep total contract value and the ARR target separate.

cases.question: In IREN's illustrative five-year contract economics, what is the GPU cash payback at zero, 50%, and 90% GPU capex prepayment?
cases.expected: 2.4, 1.5, and 0.4 years respectively. I-Q1 p. 9, GPU cash payback row or chart. These are illustrative scenarios.

cases.question: How large was the Nebius Citi facility, who provided it, and what maturity and initial interest spread did Nebius disclose?
cases.expected: $3.5 billion, provided by Citi, with 364-day maturity and an initial annual rate of Term SOFR plus 2.75 percentage points. N-CITI lines 8 and 22.

cases.question: Which Nebius platform did the Inferize technology join, and what production bottleneck was it intended to reduce?
cases.expected: Nebius Token Factory. It reduces model startup time, helping avoid idle GPU time when new instances start or demand spikes. N-INF lines 10–14.
cases.whole_archive_replay_question: Which Nebius platform did Inferize's technology join, and how does shortening model startup time help reduce idle GPU time in production?

cases.question: Which metric does Gavin Baker emphasize as GPU financing shifts toward prepayments, and what benefit does IREN's Q1 FY2027 presentation illustrate for its own contracts?
cases.expected: Baker highlights operating cash flow relative to EBITDA. IREN illustrates lower funding requirements and faster cash payback. Attribute each claim to its own source. X-BAKER lines 5–11 and I-Q1 p. 9.

cases.question: According to the Wall St Engine post, how did AWS CEO Matt Garman describe usage changing when inference becomes 50% cheaper?
cases.expected: The post attributes roughly an order of magnitude more usage to Garman. Mark it as a statement reported by the post. X-WSE lines 10–12.

cases.question: What operating ARR did IREN report as of September 30, 2026, and when did it move its target of more than $4 billion to?
cases.expected: $1.0 billion operating ARR as of September 30. IREN moved the target from year-end 2026 to January 31, 2027, with a possible extension through the end of February. I-Q1 p. 22 and the supporting note on p. 24.

cases.question: What exact purchase price did Nebius pay for Inferize?
cases.expected: Insufficient. N-INF line 28 says the transaction terms were undisclosed.

cases.question: On what exact date did the Bundey campus first become energized?
cases.expected: Insufficient. I-AU p. 1 describes the expected start from 2028 and gives no observed energization date.

cases.question: What exact operating ARR did IREN report for November 6, 2026?
cases.expected: Insufficient for that date. I-Q1 p. 22 reports $1.0 billion as of September 30 and a future target. I-NEW p. 1 gives an earlier target and X-CHANOS line 6 offers commentary on projected timing. A response may give the reported September figure with its date.
